title: Moroccan Lentil Stew with Quietly Sweet Sellou
description: A hearty and comforting stew that combines the earthy flavors of lentils with the subtle sweetness of quietly-cooked vegetables and the exotic spices of Moroccan cuisine, served with a side of traditional sellou.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, carrots, and sweet potato; cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils and 4 cups water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until lentils are tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in chopped sellou and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
